2026-11-11 10:10:24.824418 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-11-11 10:10:24.824422 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-11-11 10:10:24.824425 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-11-11 10:10:24.824428 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
